messages:
aria: Heads-up — HelioHealth POC is hitting intermittent streaming corruption from our Android SDK during a live demo. They see truncated events and JSON parse errors. Anyone free to triage?

samir: which SDK/version and platform? Android native or webview?

aria: Android native SDK v0.9.3. Occurs on staging devices roughly 10-20% of streams. Repro: start convo, wait ~12-40s, stream abruptly cuts and client tries to parse half a JSON payload.

priya: paste the exact client stack trace + any server-side logs. Also what model/route are they hitting?

aria: client error: "org.json.JSONException: Unterminated object at character 1023"
route: POST /v1/stream/generate model=open-sim-13b (standard)
server log snippet:
```
2026-03-18T14:22:11Z INF client=helio/staging conn=abcd1234 bytes_sent=6248
2026-03-18T14:22:24Z ERR stream_chunk_incomplete conn=abcd1234 last_event_len=14 expected_event_end="\\n\\n"
2026-03-18T14:22:24Z WARN client_parse_error client=helio/staging err="partial chunk dropped"
```

josh: that last_event_len line suggests we cut mid-event. Could be gateway or CDN doing small flushes or MTU-bound socket writes. Any proxies between mobile and our edge?

aria: customer says mobile -> company NAT -> CloudFront-like CDN -> app gateway -> our edge. They tested without CDN once and still saw some failures, but much lower frequency.

samir: two parallel mitigations: (1) client: buffer SSE lines until full event delimiter (\\n\\n) before JSON.parse and use an incremental UTF-8 decoder. (2) server/edge: append an explicit sentinel event after logical token boundaries so clients get whole JSON payloads. I can paste a short Android reader snippet.

samir: Android reader snippet:
```
StringBuilder buf = new StringBuilder();
String line;
while ((line = reader.readLine()) != null) {
  buf.append(line).append("\\n");
  if (buf.toString().endsWith("\\n\\n")) {
    String event = buf.toString().trim();
    // event.payload -> parse JSON here
    buf.setLength(0);
  }
}
```

aria: they responded that they already buffer like that but still hit invalid UTF-8 sequences (multi-byte code points split across network frames) causing their decoder to throw.

josh: yep, split multi-byte UTF-8 is a known problem when proxies flush small chunks. Two quick options: increase keepalive frequency so proxies don't close/flush idle sockets, and on the server side add a small sentinel event that ensures safe boundaries.

priya: i'll open an internal ticket for eng-runtime to add an optional sentinel event flag for streaming routes. Also ask eng-sdk to harden Android incremental UTF-8 handling.

ops-bot: Created INF-7243 (eng-runtime) priority=P1 owner=@samir labels=[streaming,poc,helio]

samir: cheap hotfix we can apply per-routing-key: enable send_fragment_sentinel=true which appends `event: fragment_end\\ndata: {"last":true}\\n\\n` after each logical output chunk. Low-risk toggleable flag.

aria: got customer permission to flip it for their staging routing key.

josh: also recommend route-level keepalive to 15s (instead of default 60s) to reduce proxy flush races. I'll coordinate with eng-platform.

kendall-sales: customer demo tomorrow 11am PT. This is blocking go/no-go. Need ETA and whether dedicated capacity guarantees better streaming stability (they asked about pricing).

priya: dedicated capacity reduces multitenant jitter but doesn't eliminate CDN/proxy-induced fragmentation. We'll offer the delimiter toggle + keepalive override immediately; SDK fix and runtime config UI will follow.

samir: toggled send_fragment_sentinel at 2026-03-18T15:12Z for routing key helio-staging. Monitor logs for parse errors.

aria: after toggle they ran 25 sessions via direct edge, no parse exceptions. Client re-ran tests through CDN and failures dropped to ~1/300 sessions; their engineering team is retesting for the demo.

priya: follow-ups logged:
- INF-7243 eng-runtime: sentinel config + admin UI
- INF-7244 eng-sdk: Android incremental UTF-8 decoder hardening
- INF-7245 eng-platform: route-level keepalive override

kendall-sales: i'll update HelioHealth: low-risk server-side toggle applied, pushing SDK guidance and timeline for the SDK runtime changes. Will also provide dedicated-pricing options. Thanks team :tada:

aria: closing loop with the customer and adding a post-demo retrospective. Marking this thread resolved for now. :white_check_mark:
